raw_response:
I have farmed this small piece since my mother taught me. The land is too little to buy a whole bag of fertilizer—I would throw most of it away, and I do not have cash to waste. I will spread the poultry droppings I saved behind the house on the mounds, and I will plant the same maize seed I kept from last harvest. My daughter and I will do all the work with our own hands; we have no money to hire anyone.
